sn3.16:1.5: He had hoped for a son. The girl was probably princess Vajirī, for whom the king expresses his love at [ mn87:24.1]().
sn3.16:3.2: Commentary glosses _posa_ with _posehi_, i.e. the ablative plural in comparative sense, “than men”.
sn3.16:3.3: Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad 6.4.17 gives a rite for those who wish to have a daughter who lives a full life and is an astute scholar (_paṇḍitā_).
